thread:
Kevin W: kicking off follow-up to the RFC about telemetry handoff for multi-region failover. Quick ask: what minimal event set operators need to make safe swap decisions? cc @Sasha P

Sasha P: minimal = region_swap_started, region_swap_committed, lease_evicted, kv_primed. Also need last_known_kv_checksum per tenant. Keep payload small.

Michael R: +1. We should standardize event payloads so Dedicated & Private deployments emit the same fields. Proposed small schema to discuss inline:
```json
{"event":"region_swap","tenant_id":"t-xyz","from_region":"eu-west-1","to_region":"us-west-2","lease_id":"lease-123","state":"started|committed|aborted","kv_checksum":"deadbeef","ts":6412345678}
```

Anya L: retention ask: ops needs 7 days hot, 90 days cold. For safety we also need operator alerts when swap takes > 12s for small tenants or > 60s for large. Also: obfuscate any tenant identifiers (hashing) for EU residency.

Kevin W: product question — should SDKs expose a `region_hint` header so clients can assist with locality? That would reduce blind failovers but we need a spec for header semantics.

Sasha P: yes, but fallback must exist. Also privacy note: do NOT ship PII in telemetry. Use salted tenant_id hashing at source. Include versioned schema field so we can evolve without breaking alerts.

ops-bot: deploy 641234.7 to telemetry-producer succeeded :white_check_mark:

Michael R: next steps: add schema doc to infra repo + migrate existing producers. I'll open a tiny PR and add a runbook snippet for oncall: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/multi-region-telemetry

Kevin W: thanks — can you add an example alert rule? e.g., `sum(region_swap_started) by (tenant) / sum(region_swap_committed) by (tenant) < 0.95 over 5m`

Sasha P: will do. I'll also schedule a 30m sync with eng-runtime & eng-sre tomorrow 10:00 PT to align on ingestion, partitioning, and retention costs.

Anya L: tagging legal for data-residency note: @legal-team please confirm hashed tenant_id is acceptable for EU exports.

Kevin W: noted. If legal signs off, I want to land schema + a migration plan this week. :rocket:
